name: ListAcls

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ACL IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 ACL IDs in each request
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组ID，一次最多支持查询10个访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ACL name. You can specify a maximum of ACL names in each request.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组名称。一次最多支持查询10个访问控制策略组名称。

名称长度为 1~128 个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: acl_name

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this is your first and only query, ignore this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be performed, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the ACL. The value of this parameter cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the ACL. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的标签
parameters.name: tag

AclId.description_en: The ID of the network ACL

AclName.description_en: The name of the network ACL

AclStatus.description_en:
The status of the network ACL. Valid values:

init: The network ACL is being initialized.
active: The network ACL is available.
configuring: The network ACL is being configured.
updating: The network ACL is being updated.
deleting: The network ACL is being deleted
AclStatus.description_zh:
访问控制策略组的状态。
init：初始化。
active：可用。
configuring：配置中。
updating：更新中。
deleting：删除中

The IP version of the network ACL. Valid values:

IPv4
IPv6

IPv4。
IPv6

If NextToken is not returned, it indicates that no additional results exist.
If NextToken is returned, the value is the token that is used for the next query
